full_description: stack three colored blocks into one tower in the exact bottom-to-top order named by the instruction; the colors filling the order slots change every episode, so the order words are the only signal of which block goes where
schema: {A} is the block to place at the BOTTOM (put down first), {B} is the block for the MIDDLE (placed second, onto {A}), {C} is the block for the TOP (placed last, onto {B}). The colors that fill these three slots vary per episode -- {A}/{B}/{C} are ORDER positions, NOT fixed colors. Every template MUST state the full bottom-to-top order and be unambiguous that {A} is lowest and {C} is highest. NEVER use wording that omits the order or reverses it (no 'top' for {A}, no 'bottom' for {C}, no bare 'stack them' without saying which goes on which). {a}/{b}/{c} are the arms for {A}/{B}/{C} and are optional. Slot names render as bare block phrases (e.g. 'red block'); do not add 'the' before {A}/{B}/{C}.
preference: num of words should not exceed 16. Degree of detail avg 6. Always fully specify the bottom-to-top order; keep {A} first and {C} last.
